Greeting button

This example wires a button to a click handler.

In this article

  • First

Markup

The page has one button and one output line:

html
<button id="greet">Greet</button>
<p id="out"></p>

Style

css
#out {
  font: 1rem monospace;
}

Script

js
const out = document.getElementById("out");
document.getElementById("greet").addEventListener("click", () => {
  out.textContent = "Hello!";
});
